purpose: Official DACON submission package AS-07 integrating DPR-Hybrid (Bi-Encoder Dense Phonetic Retrieval + Stage-2 4-feature scoring).
hypothesis: Connecting lightweight Bi-Encoder (DPR-SYMPHON-01) Top-35 candidates into Stage-1 retrieval and injecting 4 dense features into Stage-2 eliminates candidate dropouts on unseen foreign/noisy Hangul vessel names without throughput bottleneck.
changed_factors: Integrated HybridDenseLexicalMatcher into script.py Stage-1 retrieval (Top-35 dense candidates union)
Injected 4 phonetic similarity features (dense_sim, dense_rank_recip, dense_zscore, dense_margin_top1) into Stage-2 scorer
Bundled 2.05MB PyTorch Bi-Encoder (full_encoder.pt) and 20.12MB catalog embeddings (catalog_embeds_full_fp16.npy) inside model/
Preserved AR-06 lexical lookup, tonnage gating, and synthetic Hangul map (catalog_full_ko_map.json)
fixed_conditions: Row independence: 100% strict single vs batch inference invariance
Max 2 CPU threads capping during inference
